certificate_fee.note: Certified copy of a death certificate, San Diego County (state-set fee). Counties differ; check the county where the death occurred.

tasks.title: Report the death to Social Security

source.quote: SSA only accepts reports of death by phone or in person. They do not accept reports by email or online.

tasks.title: Return the Social Security payment for the month of death
tasks.amount_hint: the full payment received after the death
tasks.spoken: the Social Security payment that has to go back

source.quote: The SSA cannot pay benefits for the month of a recipient's death.

tasks.title: Ask Social Security about survivor benefits (appointment; it cannot be done online)

source.quote: Spouses and minor children may be eligible for Social Security survivor benefits.

tasks.title: Deliver the original will to the superior court clerk
tasks.spoken: taking the original will to the court

source.quote: the custodian of a will shall, within 30 days after having knowledge of the death of the testator ... Deliver the will to the clerk of the superior court

tasks.title: Order certified copies of the death certificate

source.quote: many people find that ten copies of the death certificate are sufficient

tasks.title: Tell Equifax (by mail, with a copy of the certificate)

source.quote: Equifax does not accept online notifications for death reports.

tasks.title: Tell Experian (by mail, with a copy of the certificate)

source.quote: Copy of the death certificate, Legal name, Social Security number, Date of birth, Date of death

tasks.title: Tell TransUnion (by mail, with a copy of the certificate)

source.quote: send the letters certified mail, return receipt requested

tasks.title: Notify the bank and ask what they need to release or retitle the account

source.quote: notify the financial institution as soon as possible

tasks.title: Notify the pension or retirement plan

source.quote: Notify government agencies, heirs, creditors, insurance, service providers and others with financial interests

tasks.title: Notify the employer (final pay, benefits, life insurance through work)

source.quote: Notify government agencies, heirs, creditors, insurance, service providers and others with financial interests
Notify government agencies, heirs, creditors, insurance, service providers and others with financial interests

tasks.title: Move or close the utility account

source.quote: memberships, subscriptions and other services will need to be canceled

tasks.title: Move or close the phone and internet account

source.quote: memberships, subscriptions and other services will need to be canceled
memberships, subscriptions and other services will need to be canceled
credit card companies, credit reporting agencies

tasks.title: Transfer the vehicle title with DMV form REG 5 (possible from day 40)
tasks.spoken: the car-title signature at the DMV

source.quote: REG 5 applies once the registered owner has been dead at least 40 days
